ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 10% high-intensity (white) to 90% low-intensity (black/dark grey) across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense high-intensity cluster at the upper-left fluke tip; multiple circular white rings mapped to the central region of the left lobe; vertical linear streak on the far-left lateral margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; vertex is submerged, but flanking lobe edges suggest an angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge shows high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (irregular peaks and valleys); right lobe shows lower-frequency, more rhythmic serration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile along the trailing edges, tapering to acute tips at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized cluster of raised white pixels (barnacles) on the left lobe tip; numerous discrete circular white ring-scars visible across the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent vertical linear disruption on the far-left edge of the fluke; scattered fine diagonal linear marks on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large cluster of barnacles on the left fluke tip and multiple circular scars consistent with previous attachment points or surface trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of a thick vertical scar on the left lateral edge and a high density of circular scarring on the left lobe compared to the right.
